steps.name: Step 2 — Click on the 'User Story Creator' agent card
Step 3 — Verify the agent detail modal opens as an overlay
Step 4 — Verify the modal displays agent icon, agent name, owner name, liked status, overflow (copy-link) menu, close button, and description
Step 5 — Verify the modal shows the "CHAT STARTERS" section
Step 6 — Verify the modal shows the "Welcome Message" section
Step 7 — Verify the "Start Chat" button is visible at the bottom of the modal
Side-channel check — zero console errors, zero 4xx/5xx
